viewsHint.all: Projects are created automatically after the first confirmed payment
viewsHint.active: New, planning, in progress, in review, waiting for client and paused
viewsHint.overdue: The project deadline has passed or there are overdue tasks

emptyText: A project appears once the first payment for a deal is confirmed.
templateHint: Task due dates are calculated from the project start date, and tasks are assigned to members with a matching role (if there is none — to the project’s Sales head (ROP)).
overdue: {count, plural, one {Overdue by # day} other {Overdue by # days}}
noMoney: The price is visible to management and the sales team

team.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the project? Their open tasks will go to the project’s Sales head (ROP).
team.emptyText: Add executors — template tasks matching their role will be transferred to them from the Sales head (ROP) automatically.
team.positionsHint: You can pick several — each position is paid separately. The first one picked is the main one.

errors.alreadyMember: The employee is already on the project team
errors.cancelReason: Specify the reason for cancelling the project
errors.deadlineBeforeStart: The deadline is earlier than the start date
errors.memberRole: Executors, managers and Sales heads (ROP) can be added to a project team
errors.openTasks: The project cannot be completed: open tasks — {count}. Complete or cancel them
errors.ropRole: The project’s Sales head (ROP) must be an employee with the ROP or CEO role

deleteConfirm: Delete project “{name}” along with its tasks? The deal, payments and financial history will be kept.
